entities.name: PMID:27513438
observations: Reports rs5743899-associated differences in human tracheobronchial epithelial responses to IL-13 and rhinovirus 16.

entities.name: TOLLIP-rhinovirus epithelial effect
observations: In donor-derived human tracheobronchial epithelial cells in an IL-13/RV16 context, rs5743899 AG/GG versus AA was associated with lower TOLLIP and antiviral-gene expression and higher IL-8; human genotype-specific viral replication was not established.
